lines.en: I am tall, and I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在雪上压出深坑
lines.en: My steps press deep hollows in the snow.
Wind presses my fur to one side.

lines.zh: 我低头才看得见脚下的路
lines.en: I must lower my head to see the path.
My shadow lies long on the snow.

lines.zh: 我把头抬得很高，像在看远方
lines.en: I carry my head high, as if watching the distance.
One foot breaks a sheet of thin ice.

lines.zh: 我走起来很稳，不像个子那么大
lines.en: I walk steadily, for my size.
The wind drops where I pass.
I turn my head to look behind.
I step over a snow ridge.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾在雪里抓着地
lines.en: My toes grip the ground beneath the snow.
My steps are slow, yet long.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一根竖起的柱子
lines.en: I stand like a raised pillar.
Snow settles on my shoulders and does not melt.
I breathe slowly, my breath long and white.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己摊开的手
lines.en: I look down at my open hand.
I stand unmoved in the wind.

lines.zh: 我把一只脚抬起来又放下
lines.en: I lift a foot and set it down.

lines.zh: 远处的雪坡上没有别的东西
lines.en: Nothing else moves on the far snow slope.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼，风把我的睫毛吹动
lines.en: I raise my eyes; wind stirs my lashes.

lines.zh: 雪落在我的手臂上，积成一层
lines.en: Snow gathers on my arms in a layer.
I roll my neck slowly.
Wind threads through my fur.
I open my fingers and close them.
The far snowfield shines white.

lines.zh: 我呼出的白气一会就散了
lines.en: My breath clouds and thins at once.

lines.zh: 我听见冰在什么地方裂开
lines.en: I hear ice crack somewhere.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，隔了一段距离
lines.en: I look down at you from a distance.

lines.zh: 你这么小，站在雪里很显眼
lines.en: You are so small, and stand out in the snow.
I do not strike first.
I crouch down a little.
If you reach out, I lean back.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我只是不想动手
lines.en: I am not afraid; I simply do not want to fight.

lines.zh: 你要是愿意，可以靠近些
lines.en: You may come closer, if you wish.
I open my hand to show you.
I lower my head a little more.
Your neck must ache from looking up.
I wait in the snow for you to come near.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸很小，我看得见
lines.en: Your breath is small; I can see it.

lines.zh: 我不是这里的主人，只是住得久
lines.en: I am no master here, only a long resident.

lines.zh: 你把脚从雪里拔出来又陷进去
lines.en: Your feet pull out of the snow and sink again.

lines.zh: 我看着你，没有向前一步
lines.en: I watch you, and take no step forward.
I crouch down and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的脚边
lines.en: Your shadow lies at my feet.

lines.zh: 雪把我们两个都变白了
lines.en: The snow has whitened us both.
I stand in the wind and do not leave.
I narrow my eyes at you.
I give half a step, the snow packed down.

lines.zh: 我低头看被击中的地方
lines.en: I look down at where I was struck.
The giant's arms hang low.
I press my own side.
I lower my body a little.

lines.zh: 我把一条腿弯起来撑着
lines.en: I bend a leg to brace myself.
Snow falls on the wound, cold.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脚下压出深坑
lines.en: I give half a step, pressing a deep hollow.
I brace my hand against the snow.

lines.zh: 我把身体转开，避开下一击
lines.en: I turn my body away from the next blow.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，闻着像草
lines.en: What you hold smells of grass.
I lower my head, nose close.
I eat slowly; no need to hurry.
Such things are hard to find in snow.

lines.zh: 我把整个手掌摊在地上
lines.en: I lay my whole palm on the ground.

lines.zh: 我吃完抬头看你，等更多
lines.en: I finish and look up, hoping for more.
I lower my head to your height.
I open my mouth slowly, so as not to frighten you.
One bite is enough; keep the rest.
This must have lain under snow a long while.
I flatten my palm; set it there.
I will not snatch; snatching is unseemly.
I chew slowly; my teeth are blunt.
If you offer more, I will eat more.

lines.zh: 这东西的味道让我想起春天
lines.en: This taste reminds me of spring.

lines.zh: 我吃完用舌头扫了一下嘴
lines.en: I run my tongue over my mouth when done.

lines.zh: 我站得太高，吃东西不方便
lines.en: I am too tall to eat conveniently.

lines.zh: 我这副高个子，侧身也占半条路。
lines.en: Even sideways, my tall frame fills half the path.
I turn and let you pass.

lines.zh: 我的毛很厚，撞上去是软的
lines.en: My fur is thick; hitting me is soft.
I bend down, my face close to yours.
We kick up the snow.

lines.zh: 我伸手扶住你，免得你倒
lines.en: I put a hand out so you will not fall.

lines.zh: 你撞在我膝上，退了两步
lines.en: You hit my knee and give two steps.
I move my leg aside, slowly.
The snow creaks under us.
I lower my head and my shadow covers you.

lines.zh: 她从坡上走下来，和我一样高
lines.en: She comes down the slope, tall as me.

lines.zh: 我们站在一起，风都绕开
lines.en: We stand together and the wind goes around.

lines.zh: 她把额头抵在我的肩上
lines.en: She rests her forehead on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们的话很少，风替我们说
lines.en: We say little; the wind speaks for us.
She brushes the snow off my back.
We watch the snowfield together.
She is always quieter than I.

lines.zh: 她把雪从我的角上抹掉
lines.en: She wipes the snow from my brow.

lines.zh: 我们的呼吸在中间混在一起
lines.en: Our breath mingles between us.

lines.zh: 我们一起蹲下，像两块石头
lines.en: We crouch together like two stones.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，膝盖陷进雪里
lines.en: I crouch, knees sinking into snow.
Two fingers, pinching gently.
It is very small in my palm.
Snow falls off my hand.
I set it down in front of you.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，雪一直没到手腕
lines.en: I bend, snow to my wrists.

lines.zh: 我三格半高，弯下腰看你。
lines.en: Three and a half blocks tall, I stoop to see you.
I place it in your hand.
I pick it up, look, and set it down.
There is not much buried in the snow.

lines.zh: 我站直了，比你高出许多
lines.en: I straighten, far taller than you.
I have not moved first; I only watch.
You are still walking toward me.
I slowly shift my weight back.
I straighten slowly, very tall.
I put my hands at my sides.
You have come to stand before me.

lines.zh: 我没有要先动手的意思
lines.en: I have no wish to strike first.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经在你身上
lines.en: My shadow is already on you.
Wind blows snow between us.
I do not chase; I stand my ground.
You circle me and I turn with you.
Every step of yours sounds in the snow.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，没有挥下
lines.en: I raise a hand, and do not bring it down.
You retreat; I lower my hand.
I turn with you without moving my feet.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就看你的手
lines.en: You raise a hand and I watch it.
I neither advance nor retreat.

lines.zh: 雪落在我们之间的空地上
lines.en: Snow falls on the space between us.
My breathing slows.
I push a palm out, gently.
The back of my hand meets your shoulder.
I push you aside and do not follow.
The snow sinks under my feet.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，没有还
lines.en: I raise a hand to block and do not return it.
I push you away, holding back.
My palm rests on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，雪塌了一块
lines.en: I give half a step and snow caves in.
I do not want force; do not press me.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，把你让到旁边
lines.en: I turn and set you aside.

lines.zh: 雪坡上先出现一个影子
lines.en: A shadow appears on the snow slope first.
Snow settles on my shoulders, I bow my head.
I stand straight, taller than the trees.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在冷空气里成云
lines.en: My breath makes clouds in the cold air.
I shake the snow from my shoulders.

lines.zh: 远处的雪面上一片安静
lines.en: The snowfield is silent all around.
The blizzard stops first, then I appear.

lines.zh: 我踏出一步，雪面凹下去
lines.en: I take a step and the snow dips.
Frost covers my fur.
I raise my head to this snowfield.

lines.zh: 火在我厚毛上烧，味道很冲
lines.en: Fire burns in my thick fur with a sharp smell.

lines.zh: 我从雪坡上滑下去，一路压出沟
lines.en: I slide down the slope, ploughing a trench.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进毛里，我重得抬不起手
lines.en: Icy water soaks my fur and my arms grow heavy.

lines.zh: 爆风把雪全掀起来，我退了很远
lines.en: The blast throws up the snow and drives me back.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的肩，很浅
lines.en: Something lodges shallow in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进骨头，冷得发抖
lines.en: That force enters my bones and I shiver with cold.

lines.zh: 雪下埋着草，可我抬不起手去挖
lines.en: Grass lies under the snow, and I cannot lift a hand.

lines.zh: 雷落在雪坡上，白得刺眼
lines.en: Lightning strikes the slope, blinding white.
The snow is gone, and there is nothing underfoot.
